purpose: fix consumer lag on the orders queue by scaling consumers
when_to_use: Use this procedure when the OrderQueueConsumerLagHigh alert fires, or when worker logs show "consumer group orders-worker lag=... on topic orders exceeds threshold=10000".
prerequisites: kubectl access to the shop namespace. The orders topic has 6 partitions. More than 6 consumers adds nothing.

steps.expect: Lag above 10000 on one or more partitions.
Memory under 80% of the limit and no recent restarts. If a worker is near its limit or restarting, stop here and follow the orders-worker OOM runbook.

steps.instruction: Check the worker logs for slow payment calls.
steps.expect: No payment-gateway timeouts. If payment calls are slow, scaling helps little. Page the payments team on-call and continue.
4 worker pods running and every partition assigned.

steps.instruction: Check the lag again after five minutes.
steps.expect: Lag is going down on every partition.

rollback.instruction: Scale back to the normal size once lag is under 1000. kubectl -n shop scale deploy/orders-worker --replicas=2

escalation: page the orders team lead if lag is still growing 15 minutes after step 4.
